text: Billing keeps the money right: payments, voids, refunds, credits and deposits, with no clinical access.
The one thing to remember: Billing handles the money, without clinical access.

Billing can also refund card payments, edit a posted payment, and issue gift cards. Cancelling a membership goes to a lead client liaison or a manager.
The most common mistake is giving Billing a client liaison role to reach a client's record. Billing already sees clients and their bills.
